notes: OH_Idle: Starts/ends in the base pose; heaves the pan onto the right shoulder (thunk at 13), picks nose 24-38, stares 44-55, wipes on shirt 59-71, pats pan 75-78, lowers it 81-90. Hips and legs are never keyed so the feet stay planted.
OH_Idle: Fastest move: RightHand turns 88 degrees in one frame at frame 84 (may look like a pop)

OH_Walk: Treadmill march, starts/ends in base pose so it loops into idle: recoil 3/19, knee lifts 9 (right) and 25 (left) with the ankle pulled back under the hip, stomps 16/32. Pan is heaved onto the right shoulder by frame 10, bounces on the stomp at 16, and swings back down to the side for the loop seam at 32.
OH_Walk: Fastest move: RightHand turns 82 degrees in one frame at frame 26 (may look like a pop)
